results.title: AI Has Done Far More Harm Than Good in My Classroom (Opinion)
results.content: Even if generative AI is allowed in classrooms, how can educators draw the line between ethical and unethical use—and hold students accountable for crossing it? Those in favor of AI integration argue that students have always cheated: If a student wants to avoid work, they can find something to copy. AI has theoretical benefits for personalized learning; it can also generate model work for critique, engage students in dialogue about a text, suggest organization strategies, and more. AI *can* be used in supportive ways that are conducive to deep learning, but that is not how most students in my classroom are using it.
